items.title: 美國經濟警訊浮現！8月消費者信心下滑 芝加哥PMI意外萎縮
items.title_en: US Economic Warning Emerges! August Consumer Confidence Slides, Chicago PMI Unexpectedly Contracts
paras: 美國8月消費者信心3個月來首度下滑，芝加哥地區商業活動更意外跌入萎縮區間，顯示家庭與企業對經濟前景的擔憂同步升高。儘管短期通膨預期降溫，物價與汽油價格居高不下，仍持續侵蝕民眾購買力。
密西根大學周五(28日)公布，8月消費者信心指數終值降至51.7，略高於初值及《彭博》調查分析師預期，但仍是3個月來首次下滑。衡量當前經濟狀況及消費者預期的分項指標均較7月下降，受訪者對未來一年與未來5年的經濟展望也同步惡化。
各政治立場受訪者的信心全面下滑，其中共和黨支持者降幅尤其明顯，信心跌至2024年11月以來最低。
密大消費者調查主任Joanne Hsu表示，除了家庭財務壓力持續影響民眾看法，消費者也愈來愈擔憂其他領域的經濟前景可能轉弱，並認為通膨在可預見的未來仍將維持高檔。
數據顯示，消費者預估未來一年物價年增率為4%，低於初值並創3月以來最低，但仍遠高於伊朗衝突爆發前2月的3.4%，也高於2024年所有數據。未來5至10年通膨預期則連續第三個月維持3.3%，同樣高於2024年介於2.8%至3.2%的區間。
中東衝突延燒及政策不確定性，成為壓抑信心的重要因素。全美平均汽油價格8月持續高於每加侖4美元，消費者也預期短期與長期油價將進一步上漲。
企業端情況更為疲弱。8月MNI芝加哥採購經理人指數(PMI)由57.6驟降至47.1，遠低於市場預估的57.9，跌破象徵景氣擴張與萎縮分界的50，單月降幅更創新冠疫情以來最大。與此同時，企業支付價格指標反而加速上升，反映商業活動急凍之際，成本壓力仍未消退。
整體而言，即使美股徘徊歷史高點，企業活動卻浮現類似衰退的警訊，一般消費者信心也持續轉弱，凸顯美國經濟正同時面對成長降溫與通膨偏高的雙重壓力。
paras_en: US consumer confidence fell for the first time in three months in August, and business activity in the Chicago region unexpectedly slipped into contraction, indicating that worries about the economic outlook are rising simultaneously among households and firms. Although short‑term inflation expectations have cooled, prices and gasoline remain high, continuing to erode purchasing power.

The University of Michigan released its August consumer sentiment index on Friday (the 28th), with the final reading dropping to 51.7, slightly above the preliminary figure and Bloomberg analysts’ expectations, but still marking the first decline in three months. Both the current‑conditions and expectations sub‑indices fell from July, and respondents’ outlook for the next year and the next five years also deteriorated.
Confidence fell across all political affiliations, with the drop among Republican supporters especially pronounced, reaching the lowest level since November 2024.

Joanne Hsu, director of the Michigan consumer survey, said that beyond ongoing household‑financial pressure shaping public opinion, consumers are increasingly worried that other areas of the economy could weaken, and they expect inflation to remain elevated in the foreseeable future.

The data show that consumers expect prices to rise 4% over the next year, a figure lower than the preliminary estimate and the lowest since March, yet still well above the 3.4% rate recorded two months before the Iran conflict erupted and higher than any figure in 2024. Inflation expectations for the next 5‑10 years stayed at 3.3% for the third consecutive month, also above the 2024 range of 2.8%‑3.2%.

Escalating Middle‑East conflicts and policy uncertainty are key factors dampening confidence. The national average gasoline price remained above $4 per gallon throughout August, and consumers expect both short‑term and long‑term oil prices to rise further.

Business conditions are even weaker. The August MNI Chicago Purchasing Managers’ Index (PMI) plunged from 57.6 to 47.1, far below the market forecast of 57.9 and beneath the 50 threshold that separates expansion from contraction, marking the largest monthly drop since the COVID‑19 pandemic began. At the same time, the corporate price‑pay index accelerated upward, reflecting that cost pressures persist even as commercial activity freezes.

Overall, even as US equities hover near historic highs, corporate activity is showing recession‑like warning signs and consumer confidence continues to weaken, highlighting that the US economy is facing the dual pressure of slowing growth and persistently high inflation.

items.title: 華許放鷹牽動債市！2年期美債殖利率急升5基點
items.title_en: Warsh's Hawkish Tone Moves Bond Market! 2-Year US Treasury Yield Jumps 5 Basis Points
paras: 聯準會(Fed)主席華許(Kevin Warsh)周五(28日)在傑克森霍爾央行年會強調抑制通膨的決心，緩解市場對其抗通膨可信度的部分疑慮。演說期間，短期美債價格下跌、長期美債走高，殖利率曲線進一步趨平，反映投資人預期Fed可能必須升息壓制物價。
截稿前，對利率政策較為敏感的2年期美債殖利率上升5個基點至4.28%，30年期美債殖利率則下跌1個基點至5.19%。殖利率與債券價格呈反向走勢。
短債殖利率上升顯示交易員提高對Fed升息的預期，長債殖利率回落則反映市場對長期通膨失控的擔憂有所降溫。華許的演說也在一定程度上恢復投資人對Fed維護物價穩定的信心。
自華許6月首次主持記者會以來，債券交易員便持續揣測他的政策立場。華許當時強調，必須讓自2021年全球經濟走出新冠疫情後便長期高於目標的通膨降溫，語氣偏向鷹派。
不過，Fed於7月再度按兵不動，華許也拒絕預告今年是否可能升息，導致長期美債殖利率大幅攀升。投資人擔心，若Fed未能及時抑制物價，未來通膨風險將進一步升高，因此要求持有長債時獲得更高的風險補償。
華許周五表示，近期通膨數據尚未顯示物價壓力出現有意義的放緩。決策官員必須確信通膨正朝目標下降，否則Fed就「還有工作要做」。
他也重申，Fed將使通膨回到2%，並強調2%是「堅定且固定的目標」，並非可隨經濟或政治環境調整的彈性標準。相關談話讓市場認為，若接下來的通膨數據持續偏高，Fed仍可能進一步收緊貨幣政策。
paras_en: Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh emphasized his determination to curb inflation at the Jackson Hole central‑bank symposium on Friday (the 28th), easing some market doubts about the Fed’s anti‑inflation credibility. During his remarks, short‑term U.S. Treasury prices fell while long‑term Treasuries rose, flattening the yield curve and reflecting investors’ view that the Fed may need to raise rates to restrain prices.
At the close of the article, the rate‑sensitive 2‑year Treasury yield had risen 5 basis points to 4.28%, while the 30‑year yield slipped 1 basis point to 5.19%. Yields move inversely to bond prices.

The rise in short‑term yields signals traders are pricing in a higher probability of a Fed rate hike, whereas the dip in long‑term yields indicates that concerns over runaway long‑run inflation have cooled. Warsh’s speech also helped restore some investor confidence that the Fed will keep price stability intact.

Since Warsh first held a press conference in June, bond traders have been speculating about his policy stance. At that time he stressed the need to bring inflation— which had been persistently above target since the global economy emerged from the pandemic in 2021— back down, adopting a decidedly hawkish tone.

However, the Fed held rates steady again in July, and Warsh declined to signal whether another hike might come this year, prompting a sharp rise in long‑term Treasury yields. Investors worry that if the Fed fails to curb prices promptly, inflation risks will rise further, demanding higher risk premiums for holding long‑dated bonds.

Warsh said on Friday that recent inflation data have not shown a meaningful easing of price pressures. Policymakers must be convinced that inflation is moving toward the target, otherwise the Fed “still has work to do.”

He reiterated that the Fed will bring inflation back to 2% and stressed that the 2% goal is “firm and fixed,” not a flexible benchmark that can be adjusted for economic or political conditions. His comments led the market to believe that if inflation data remain elevated, the Fed could tighten monetary policy further.

items.title: 西藏尼泊爾邊境山洪 中國無人機「空投」消防員
items.title_en: Tibet-Nepal Border Landslide: China Deploys UAVs to Air‑Drop Firefighters
paras: 尼泊爾一側發生泥石流災害，造成西藏日喀則市吉隆縣吉隆口岸重大人員傷亡、失聯。據初步統計，截至27日（周四）上午8時，中國救援隊成功搜救熱索村民2人，排查發現遇難3人、失聯558人，其中外籍人員260人。
目前消防救援隊伍採取「水陸空」並進模式，挺進受災核心區。
據《觀察者網》28日報導，按照救援行動方案，中國消防救援隊伍設立了三支專項救援作業隊伍，陸路兩支消防救援分隊翻山前進，水域採取橡皮艇編隊挺進受災核心區，空中使用大載重無人機投送消防員，已到達吉隆口岸。
據《新華社》報導，中國國家消防救援局說，截至28日10時，國家綜合性消防救援隊伍共調派681人、113車到達現場救援（西藏消防總隊415人、75車，四川機動總隊155人、38車，四川消防救援總隊為主的中國救援隊111人），並調撥3類19個品種6612件（套）救援裝備和綜合保障物資發往吉隆鎮。
同時，中國派出前突小分隊，運用無人機、望遠鏡對受災核心區、堰塞湖區域展開測繪偵察、定點監測觀察。上海消防研究所13名專家均已抵達。
中國安能偵測分隊15人28日攜帶偵測無人機、衛星便攜站、通訊布控球等偵測通訊裝備赴郭巴怒曲區域，對堰塞體及周邊道路展開現場勘察，為堰塞湖科學處置提供精準數據支撐。
paras_en: A landslide on the Nepal side caused major casualties and missing persons at the Jilong Port in Jilong County, Shigatse City, Tibet. Preliminary counts as of 8 a.m. on Thursday, the 27th, show that Chinese rescue teams have recovered two villagers, found three deceased, and identified 558 missing, including 260 foreigners.
The firefighting and rescue teams are operating in a combined water‑land‑air mode, pushing into the core disaster area.

According to Observer.com on the 28th, following the rescue plan, Chinese firefighting units formed three specialized teams: two land teams crossed the mountains, a water team advanced in rubber‑boat formations into the core area, and a heavy‑payload UAV delivered firefighters to Jilong Port.

Xinhua reported that by 10 a.m. on the 28th, the national comprehensive firefighting and rescue force had deployed 681 people and 113 vehicles to the scene (415 people and 75 vehicles from the Tibet Fire Brigade, 155 people and 38 vehicles from the Sichuan Mobile Brigade, and 111 people from the Sichuan Fire Rescue Brigade as the main Chinese rescue team). They also dispatched 19 categories of 6,612 pieces of rescue equipment and comprehensive support supplies to Jilong Town.

Meanwhile, China sent a forward reconnaissance squad that used UAVs and binoculars to map and monitor the core disaster area and the moraine lake zone, with 13 Shanghai Fire Research Institute experts already on site.

A 15‑person detection squad from China’s Anan Intelligence and Detection Unit carried detection UAVs, satellite portable stations, and communication deployment spheres to the Guoba Nucu area on the 28th, conducting on‑site surveys of the moraine and surrounding roads to provide precise data for scientific management of the moraine lake.

items.title: 華許放鷹了！通膨不乖乖降 Fed就得繼續出手
items.title_en: Warsh Unleashes the Hawk! If Inflation Won't Calm, the Fed Must Keep Acting
paras: 聯準會(Fed)主席華許(Kevin Warsh)周五(28日)在傑克森霍爾央行年會發表上任後首場重要演說，警告美國通膨並未出現有意義的放緩，並重申2%是「堅定且固定」的目標。儘管他未明確支持9月升息，卻表示當前金融環境難言具有限制性，若基礎通膨未以足夠快的速度回落，Fed就「還有工作要做」，為進一步升息保留空間。

通膨改善不足以讓Fed放心

華許表示，Fed必須確信基礎通膨正明確且快速地朝2%目標前進，否則就必須採取行動，「這是我們的工作、使命與責任」。
他承認，今年夏季公布的個人消費支出(PCE)物價指數及消費者物價指數(CPI)均優於預期，但這些數據尚不足以證明通膨趨勢已有實質改善。Fed偏好的PCE物價指數7月年增率仍達3.7%，高於2%目標已有逾5年。
更令華許擔憂的是，漲價範圍依然廣泛。目前PCE商品與服務項目中，約有一半價格年增逾3%，儘管低於疫情後通膨高峰，仍明顯高於疫情前20年約三分之一的正常比例。
華許表示，過去兩年的抗通膨進展相當有限，目前市場通膨預期雖仍受到控制，但Fed必須密切關注，確保預期不會脫離錨定。「物價穩定不會自動發生，通膨也不一定自行回歸平均水準，讓物價恢復穩定是Fed的工作。」
他也淡化薪資成長趨緩帶來的正面訊號。傳統經濟模型通常認為薪資放緩有助壓低通膨，但華許指出，長久以來，薪資成長都不是可靠的未來通膨指標。

金融環境不緊為升息留下空間

Fed目前將聯邦基金利率維持在3.5%至3.75%，自去年12月以來已連續5次按兵不動。不過，華許認為，現行利率並未對經濟形成太大約束，信貸與放款市場幾乎看不到政策限制的跡象。
他指出，儘管房市及農業浮現部分壓力，整體金融環境仍很難被形容為具有限制性。美國經濟面對多重衝擊仍展現韌性，信用利差接近歷史低檔，企業投資成長更創2021年以來最快。
華許強調，當通膨高於2%時，Fed目前的首要關注重點就是物價，而短期利率仍是實現充分就業及物價穩定雙重使命的主要工具。相關說法被市場解讀為，若未來數據顯示通膨持續頑強，他已準備支持升息。
Fed內部對政策方向也存在分歧。7月會議維持利率不變時，共有3名官員投下反對票、主張升息，其他決策官員也表示，若通膨未能降溫，可能加入支持緊縮政策的行列。
華許表示，7月選擇等待更多資訊是較明智的做法，特別是供應鏈、投資流動及地緣政治局勢仍可能出現變化。他並未說明9月會議將採取何種行動，而是強調：「我今天承諾的是一套紀律，而不是一項決定。」

華許拒給路徑市場升息押注升溫

華許明確表示，這次演說不應被視為前瞻指引或政策反應函數。他認為，前瞻指引在危機時期或許有其作用，但在正常環境下，可能「以清晰之名製造模糊」，甚至限制決策官員在關鍵時刻作出正確選擇的自由。
他也反駁市場要求Fed明確交代短期政策路徑的呼聲，直言央行對經濟的理解尚未精準到足以提供機械化且屢試不爽的答案，影響貨幣政策的關鍵因素也會隨時間改變，投資人應自行形成對經濟及利率走向的判斷。
不過，相較前兩次記者會，華許此次更詳細說明對通膨、經濟與政策優先順序的看法，在一定程度上回應外界對其溝通缺乏清晰度的批評。Inflation Insights總裁Omair Sharif表示，華許向市場提供期待已久的通膨觀點，同時又未提前暴露政策決定，對華許與市場而言可說是雙贏。
市場隨即提高升息押注。Fed 9月升息機率由演說前約36%至40%，升至逾50%；2年期美債殖利率一度大漲9個基點至4.32%，創約一個月新高，30年期殖利率則下跌2個基點至5.17%。短債殖利率上升、長債回落，顯示投資人認為Fed可能升息壓制物價，長期通膨失控風險則有所降低。
前Fed副主席克拉里達(Richard Clarida)指出，現在每一場會議都可能調整利率；若決策官員看不到通膨改善，「他們已準備好升息」。Fed將於9月11日取得8月CPI數據，並於9月15日至16日召開利率會議，就業、失業率及通膨數據將成為決策關鍵。
paras_en: Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh delivered his first major speech since taking office on Friday (the 28th) at the Jackson Hole central bank symposium, warning that U.S. inflation has not shown a meaningful slowdown and reiterating that 2% remains a "firm and fixed" target. Although he did not explicitly endorse a September rate hike, he said the current financial environment is not clearly restrictive, and if core inflation does not fall fast enough, the Fed "still has work to do," leaving room for further tightening.
Warsh said the Fed must be convinced that core inflation is moving clearly and quickly toward the 2% goal; otherwise action is required, "that is our job, mission, and responsibility."

He acknowledged that this summer’s personal consumption expenditures (PCE) price index and consumer price index (CPI) both came in better than expected, but that the data are still insufficient to prove a substantive improvement in the inflation trend. The Fed‑preferred PCE price index’s July year‑over‑year rate remained at 3.7%, more than five years above the 2% target.

What worries Warsh even more is that price increases remain broad‑based. About half of the items in the PCE goods and services basket are seeing annual price gains above 3%; while lower than the post‑pandemic peak, this is still markedly higher than the roughly one‑third normal rate seen in the two decades before the pandemic.

Warsh noted that anti‑inflation progress over the past two years has been modest, and although market inflation expectations are still contained, the Fed must watch them closely to ensure they stay anchored. "Price stability does not happen automatically, and inflation does not necessarily revert to average levels on its own; restoring price stability is the Fed’s job," he said.

He also downplayed the positive signal from slowing wage growth. Traditional economic models often assume that slower wages help lower inflation, but Warsh pointed out that wages have long been an unreliable predictor of future inflation.

Financial conditions are not tight enough to preclude rate hikes. The Fed currently holds the federal funds rate at 3.5%‑3.75%, unchanged for five consecutive meetings since December last year. However, Warsh believes the current rate does not impose a heavy constraint on the economy, and credit and lending markets show little sign of policy‑driven restriction.

He noted that despite some pressure in the housing and agricultural sectors, the overall financial environment is far from being restrictive. The U.S. economy remains resilient amid multiple shocks, credit spreads are near historic lows, and corporate investment growth is the fastest since 2021.

Warsh emphasized that as long as inflation stays above 2%, the Fed’s primary focus remains on prices, and short‑term rates remain the main tool for achieving the dual mandate of full employment and price stability. Markets interpreted this as a signal that if data continue to show stubborn inflation, he is ready to support another hike.

There are also internal divisions within the Fed on policy direction. At the July meeting that left rates unchanged, three officials voted against the decision and advocated a hike, and other policymakers indicated they might join the tightening camp if inflation does not cool.

Warsh said waiting for more information in July was the wiser approach, especially as supply‑chain dynamics, investment flows, and geopolitical developments could still shift. He did not specify what action the September meeting would take, but stressed, "What I am committing to today is a framework of discipline, not a specific decision."

Warsh rejected market speculation that the speech signaled a hotter path for rate hikes. He made clear that the remarks should not be treated as forward guidance or a policy reaction function. He believes forward guidance may have a role in crises, but in normal times it can "create opacity under the guise of clarity" and even limit policymakers’ freedom to make the right choices at critical moments.

He also pushed back against calls for the Fed to spell out a short‑term policy path, stating that the central bank’s understanding of the economy is not precise enough to provide a mechanical, fool‑proof answer, and that the key drivers of monetary policy will evolve over time, leaving investors to form their own views on the economy and rate trajectory.

Compared with his first two press briefings, Warsh this time offered a more detailed view of his thinking on inflation, the economy, and policy priorities, partially addressing criticism of his earlier lack of clarity. Inflation Insights CEO Omair Sharif said Warsh gave the market a long‑awaited inflation perspective while not pre‑emptively revealing policy decisions, a win‑win for both Warsh and the market.

Markets immediately raised rate‑hike bets. The probability of a September Fed hike rose from roughly 36% before the speech to about 40% and then over 50%; the two‑year Treasury yield jumped 9 basis points to 4.32%, a one‑month high, while the 30‑year yield fell 2 basis points to 5.17%. The rise in short‑term yields and fall in long‑term yields suggest investors think a hike could curb prices while long‑term inflation risks are easing.

Former Fed Vice Chair Richard Clarida warned that every upcoming meeting could adjust rates; if policymakers see no inflation improvement, "they are ready to hike." The Fed will receive August CPI data on September 11 and convene its rate‑policy meeting on September 15‑16, with employment, unemployment and inflation figures set to be decisive.

items.title: 〈美股早盤〉主要指數漲跌互見 市場靜待華許傑克森霍爾演說
items.title_en: U.S. Stocks Mixed in Early Trade as Market Awaits Fed Chair Warsh's Jackson Hole Speech
paras: 美股主要指數周五(28日)開盤漲跌互見，AI題材帶動的漲勢暫時降溫，投資人也不願在聯準會(Fed)主席華許(Kevin Warsh)於傑克森霍爾央行年會發表重磅演說前大舉押注。市場期待華許展現抑制高通膨的堅定立場，以穩定長期美債市場；晶片股漲勢稍作休息，邁威爾(Marvell)財報未能提振投資人信心。
截稿前，道瓊工業指數漲近80點或近0.1%，那斯達克綜合指數漲近40點或近0.2%，標普 500 指數漲近0.2%，費城半導體指數跌近1.0%。台積電 ADR 漲近0.1%。
美股主要指數期貨周五(28日)漲跌互見，投資人不願在聯準會(Fed)主席華許(Kevin Warsh)於傑克森霍爾央行年會發表演說前大舉押注，靜待他進一步說明經濟展望，以及讓通膨重返2%目標的政策策略。
截稿前，標普500指數期貨大致持平，本周仍可望收高；那斯達克100指數期貨則回吐輝達(NVDA-US)強勁財測帶動的部分漲幅。PayPal(PYPL-US)盤前重挫14%，主因私募股權公司Advent與支付業者Stripe放棄尋求收購該公司。
其他市場方面，美元與黃金價格變動不大，布蘭特原油震盪，美債殖利率全線走高，其中30年期美債殖利率上升2個基點至5.21%。銅價則邁向連續第九周上漲，將創2020年以來最長周線漲勢。
華許預定於美東時間上午10時發表演說。在市場質疑他抑制通膨的決心之際，長期美債殖利率近期持續攀升，加上聯準會決策官員立場分歧，以及美國財政部介入債市，令本次演說格外受到關注。
Edmond de Rothschild資產管理投資長Nabil Milali表示，華許近期發言過於模糊，導致市場完全無法掌握演說方向，部分投資人預期他將釋出非常鷹派的訊號，其他人則認為可能正好相反，因此不願在演說前幾個小時擴大部位。
摩根大通資產管理全球市場策略師Hugh Gimber指出，投資人最希望了解的是聯準會評估經濟情勢的政策框架，以便更準確解讀接下來公布的經濟數據，而這正是目前市場欠缺的關鍵資訊。
Berenberg策略師Ulrich Urbahn認為，本次演說對外匯、黃金與債券市場的影響，可能大於股市。若華許在通膨、財政可信度或維持限制性政策方面釋出強硬立場，長期實質與名目殖利率可能進一步上升，同時支撐美元並壓低對利率敏感的資產。
歐洲股市方面，道瓊歐洲Stoxx 600指數在消費類股回升帶動下反彈，有望避開2024年以來最長的周線連跌紀錄。西班牙與法國通膨加速，也強化歐洲央行下月升息的理由。
日元則領跌主要貨幣，再度逼近1美元兌160日元，並朝7月底美日聯手干預以來最低水準邁進。日本財務省周五公布，政府過去一個月已投入創紀錄的964億美元支撐日元。

華爾街分析：

穆迪評等分析師表示，大規模人工智慧投資可能會削弱美國超大規模雲端服務商的信用指標，但雄厚的資本緩衝可以緩解相關壓力。隨著資本支出成長超過經營活動現金流，美國超大規模雲端服務商的自由現金流預計將在2026年至2027年下降。
隨著Meta(META-US)、Alphabet(GOOGL-US)和甲骨文(ORCL-US)等公司增加債券發行，槓桿壓力預計將進一步加劇。不過，超大規模雲端服務商均擁有龐大的現金儲備，加上營收和息稅折舊攤銷前利潤(EBITDA)成長，使其能夠承受12至24個月的高額資本支出，而不會顯著損害信用品質。
paras_en: U.S. equity indices opened mixed on Friday (the 28th), with AI‑driven gains cooling temporarily as investors shied away from making large bets before Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh delivers a heavyweight speech at the Jackson Hole central‑bank symposium. The market is looking for Warsh to demonstrate a firm stance on curbing high inflation to stabilize the long‑term U.S. bond market; chip stocks took a brief breather, and Marvell’s earnings failed to lift investor confidence.

At the time of writing, the Dow Jones Industrial Average was up about 80 points, roughly 0.1%, the Nasdaq Composite rose about 40 points, roughly 0.2%, the S&P 500 gained about 0.2%, while the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index fell about 1.0%. TSMC ADR was up about 0.1%.

U.S. equity index futures were mixed on Friday (the 28th) as investors avoided piling in ahead of Fed Chair Kevin Warsh’s speech at the Jackson Hole central‑bank meeting, waiting for him to elaborate on the economic outlook and policy strategy to bring inflation back to the 2% target.

At the time of writing, S&P 500 futures were roughly flat, with the week still expected to close higher; Nasdaq‑100 futures gave back some of the gains sparked by Nvidia’s strong earnings forecast. PayPal (PYPL‑US) was down 14% pre‑market after private‑equity firm Advent and payments firm Stripe abandoned their bid to acquire the company.

In other markets, the dollar and gold showed little movement, Brent crude was range‑bound, and U.S. Treasury yields rose across the board, with the 30‑year yield climbing 2 basis points to 5.21%. Copper continued its upward streak for a ninth consecutive week, on track for the longest weekly rally since 2020.

Warsh is scheduled to speak at 10:00 a.m. Eastern Time. With the market questioning his resolve to tame inflation, long‑term Treasury yields have been climbing, Fed officials are split on policy, and the Treasury has stepped into the bond market, making his remarks especially closely watched.

Edmond de Rothschild asset‑management chief investment officer Nabil Milali said Warsh’s recent comments have been too vague, leaving the market unable to gauge the direction of his speech; some investors expect a very hawkish signal, others think the opposite, so they are reluctant to expand positions in the hours before the talk.

JPMorgan Chase asset‑management global market strategist Hugh Gimber noted that investors most want to understand the Fed’s policy framework for assessing economic conditions, to better interpret upcoming economic data, a piece of information the market currently lacks.

Berenberg strategist Ulrich Urbahn believes the speech’s impact could be larger on FX, gold and bond markets than on equities. If Warsh delivers a tough stance on inflation, fiscal credibility or maintaining restrictive policy, real and nominal long‑term yields could rise further, supporting the dollar and pressuring rate‑sensitive assets.

In European equities, the Stoxx 600 rebounded on a recovery in consumer stocks, potentially avoiding the longest weekly decline since early 2024. Accelerating inflation in Spain and France also bolsters the case for a European Central Bank rate hike next month.

The yen led losses among major currencies, again approaching ¥160 per dollar and moving toward its lowest level since the joint U.S.–Japan intervention at the end of July. Japan’s finance ministry reported on Friday that the government has spent a record $96.4 billion over the past month to support the yen.

Key stock:
PayPal (PYPL‑US) down 13.19% in early trade to $53.37

PayPal’s pre‑market price plunged nearly 16% on Friday. Bloomberg cited sources saying private‑equity firm Advent and payments company Stripe have decided not to pursue a PayPal acquisition. Sources added that, had the deal gone through, it could have been one of the largest leveraged buyouts in history.
Affirm (AFRM‑US) was up 15.01% in early trade to $89.13 per share.

Buy‑now‑pay‑later provider Affirm saw its pre‑market price surge 13% on Friday. The company reported fourth‑quarter revenue of $1.17 billion, above LSEG analysts’ estimate of $1.11 billion, and its first‑quarter revenue outlook also beat expectations.
Gap (GAP‑US) rose 20.25% in early trade to $25.00 per share.

Gap’s pre‑market price jumped nearly 15% on Friday after the company announced Michael Francis will take over the Old Navy brand on November 2, replacing Haio Barbeito, who has led the chain since 2022. Gap also reported adjusted Q2 earnings of $0.52 per share, above LSEG analysts’ forecast of $0.48.

Key economic data today:

U.S. August consumer confidence index expected at 51.0, down from 55.2 previously.

Wall Street analysis:
Moody’s rating analysts said massive AI investment could weaken the credit metrics of U.S. hyperscale cloud providers, but strong capital buffers can mitigate the pressure. With capex outpacing operating cash flow, free cash flow for these providers is projected to decline in 2026‑27.

As companies such as Meta (META‑US), Alphabet (GOOGL‑US) and Oracle (ORCL‑US) increase bond issuance, leverage pressure is expected to intensify. However, hyperscale cloud firms hold large cash reserves and see EBITDA growth, allowing them to sustain 12‑24 months of high capex without materially harming credit quality.

items.title: 〈財報〉AI記憶體缺貨讓它賺翻！長鑫存儲H1營收暴增近10倍
items.title_en: [Earnings] AI Memory Shortage Boosts Profits! CXMT H1 Revenue Surges Nearly 10‑Fold
paras: 中國記憶體晶片製造商長鑫存儲(CXMT)受惠人工智慧(AI)熱潮引發的全球記憶體缺貨，上半年營收暴增近10倍並轉虧為盈，雙雙超越公司預期。自7月在上海掛牌以來，長鑫存儲股價已漲逾5倍，市值更超越騰訊(00700-HK)，成為中國市值最高的上市公司。
長鑫存儲周五(28日)公布，2026年上半年營收達人民幣1,503.1億元(約223.6億美元)，較去年同期成長近10倍，不僅超越公司原先預估的人民幣1,100億至1,200億元，更是2025年全年營收的兩倍以上；淨利達人民幣776.1億元，優於財測並扭轉去年同期虧損。

AI記憶體缺貨帶來暴利

隨著AI業者積極搶購資料中心所需記憶體，全球供應日益吃緊並推升價格，讓長鑫存儲與三星電子、SK海力士(SKHY-US)、美光(MU-US)等業者共同受惠。研究機構TrendForce估計，伺服器動態隨機存取記憶體(DRAM)合約價在2025年下半年已上漲64%，今年更可能再漲270%。
長鑫存儲表示，全球DRAM供給緊張是業績大幅成長的主要原因，預期此一趨勢將延續至下半年。公司新一代低功耗記憶體LPDDR6已送交客戶驗證，目前正朝量產階段推進，可望應用於高階智慧手機、平板電腦及其他AI裝置。
市場也看好長鑫存儲持續擴大市占。摩根士丹利預估，在中國AI基礎建設需求及產能擴張帶動下，長鑫存儲占全球DRAM位元出貨量比重，可望從今年的11%提高至2030年的15%。
長鑫存儲上月完成中國第二大規模的上海首次公開募股(IPO)，計入超額配售選擇權後募得人民幣666億元。掛牌首日股價漲逾5倍，目前市值已逼近6,000億美元，並超越騰訊(00700-HK)，反映中國科技市場的重心逐漸轉向AI與半導體。

技術差距與美國制裁仍是考驗

長鑫存儲由曾赴美受訓的半導體業者朱一明於2016年創辦，是目前全球第四大DRAM製造商，也是中國降低對外國晶片依賴的重要企業。隨著美中科技競爭升溫，投資人押注中國客戶將加快以國產記憶體取代海外產品。
不過，三星電子、SK海力士與美光仍控制全球逾90%的DRAM市場。分析師估計，長鑫存儲在先進AI記憶體方面落後領先業者兩至三個世代，未來能否快速縮小技術差距，將是長期發展的關鍵。公司正研發用於AI加速器的高頻寬記憶體(HBM)，但本次財報並未揭露相關進度。
長鑫存儲計畫將IPO資金用於擴充產能及追趕國際對手。上半年研發支出年增87%至人民幣68.6億元，研發團隊規模也擴大61%至近7,500人。
在全球供應緊張之際，蘋果(AAPL-US)據傳正與長鑫存儲及長江存儲洽談，希望採購記憶體用於在中國銷售的裝置。蘋果執行長庫克(Tim Cook)日前被問及是否可能放寬採購限制時表示，所有選項都必須納入考量，但相關討論已引發美國議員反彈。
長鑫存儲近期也遭美國國防部列入黑名單，不過公司強調，此舉不會影響日常營運。高盛認為，即使股價大漲，長鑫存儲目前估值約為2027年預估獲利的10倍，仍明顯低於國際同業。
paras_en: China memory chip maker CXMT benefited from the AI‑driven global memory shortage, with first‑half revenue jumping nearly tenfold and turning a profit, both surpassing company expectations. Since its July listing in Shanghai, CXMT’s share price has risen over fivefold, and its market cap now exceeds Tencent (00700‑HK), making it China’s highest‑valued listed company.

CXMT announced on Friday (the 28th) that H1 2026 revenue reached RMB 150.31 billion (about US$22.36 billion), up almost ten times year‑over‑year, exceeding its prior guidance of RMB 110‑120 billion and more than double its full‑year 2025 forecast; net profit was RMB 77.61 billion, beating forecasts and reversing last year’s loss.

AI memory shortage brings huge margins. As AI firms scramble for data‑center memory, global supply tightens and prices rise, benefitting CXMT alongside Samsung Electronics, SK Hynix (SKHY‑US) and Micron (MU‑US). Research firm TrendForce estimates server DRAM contract prices have risen 64% by the second half of 2025 and could climb another 270% this year.

CXMT says the tight global DRAM supply is the main driver of the surge and expects the trend to continue into the second half. Its next‑generation low‑power memory LPDDR6 has been sent to customers for validation and is moving toward mass production, expected for high‑end smartphones, tablets and other AI devices.

The market is also bullish on CXMT’s share‑gain. Morgan Stanley projects that, driven by China’s AI infrastructure demand and capacity expansion, CXMT’s share of global DRAM bit shipments could rise from 11% this year to 15% by 2030.

Last month CXMT completed China’s second‑largest Shanghai IPO, raising RMB 66.6 billion after including the overallotment option. On debut day the share price jumped over fivefold; its market value is now close to US$600 billion, overtaking Tencent (00700‑HK), reflecting the shift of China’s tech market focus toward AI and semiconductors.

Technology gap and U.S. sanctions remain challenges. CXMT was founded in 2016 by semiconductor veteran Zhu Yiming, who trained in the United States; it is now the world’s fourth‑largest DRAM maker and a key Chinese effort to reduce reliance on foreign chips. As U.S.–China tech rivalry heats up, investors bet Chinese customers will accelerate replacing foreign memory with domestic products.

However, Samsung, SK Hynix and Micron still control over 90% of the global DRAM market. Analysts estimate CXMT lags leading players by two to three generations in advanced AI memory; closing that gap quickly will be critical for long‑term growth. The company is developing high‑bandwidth memory (HBM) for AI accelerators, but the current earnings report did not disclose progress.
CXMT plans to use IPO proceeds to expand capacity and chase international rivals. R&D spending rose 87% year‑over‑year to RMB 6.86 billion in H1, and the R&D team grew 61% to nearly 7,500 staff.

Amid tight global supply, Apple (AAPL‑US) is reportedly in talks with CXMT and Yangtze Memory (YMTC) to procure memory for devices sold in China. CEO Tim Cook, when asked whether procurement restrictions might be eased, said all options must be considered, but the discussion has sparked backlash from U.S. lawmakers.

CXMT was recently placed on a U.S. Department of Defense blacklist, but the company says this will not affect day‑to‑day operations. Goldman Sachs believes that despite the stock’s surge, CXMT’s valuation is about 10 times its projected 2027 earnings, still well below international peers.

items.title: 〈財報〉出口救了比亞迪！第二季獲利大增近30%
items.title_en: <Earnings> Exports Saved BYD! Q2 Profit Surges Nearly 30%
paras: 中國電動車龍頭比亞迪(01211-HK)第二季獲利年增近30%，終結連續四季下滑，在中國市場需求疲弱之際，海外出口大幅成長及較高價車款熱銷，成為推動業績反彈的主要力量。
根據比亞迪周五(28日)公布的上半年財報推算，第二季淨利年增29.8%至人民幣82億元(約12.2億美元)，略高於《彭博》調查分析師平均預估的人民幣80億元，並扭轉第一季淨利大減55.4%的頹勢。單季營收則年減3.2%至人民幣1,946億元，降幅較第一季的11.8%明顯收斂，但已連續第四季下滑。
比亞迪先前受到中國電動車市場價格戰，以及小米(01810-HK)、小鵬汽車(09868-HK)(XPEV-US)等對手競爭影響，獲利已低迷長達一年。為降低對中國市場的依賴，公司積極拓展南美洲、歐洲與東南亞，藉由推出新車及改款熱門車型拉高銷量。由於海外市場售價與利潤率通常優於中國，出口成長也改善整體獲利表現。
中國車市低迷情況仍未明顯好轉。受車廠持續降價促銷影響，包括比亞迪在內的多數車企7月營收均較去年同期下滑。中國乘用車市場資訊聯席會數據顯示，7月中國乘用車總銷量年減21%，但同期中國乘用車海外銷量大增88%，凸顯出口已成為中國車廠最主要的成長引擎。
比亞迪上半年共售出181萬輛汽車，距離全年500萬至550萬輛目標仍有不小差距，7月交車表現也不足以讓公司跟上年度目標進度。不過，分析師預期，隨著生產問題逐步解決及出口持續攀升，比亞迪下半年獲利復甦可望加速，第四季營收與獲利甚至可能雙雙創下歷史新高。
海外擴張仍面臨政策風險。歐盟正考慮對中國混合動力車加徵關稅，比亞迪在匈牙利興建的旗艦工廠也因分包商涉及勞動爭議，以及政府補貼、租稅優惠與環境豁免遭調查，投產時間已延至第四季，較原訂計畫晚約一年。比亞迪表示，公司在當地均遵守相關法律規定。
此外，比亞迪也開始在向來難以打入的日本市場銷售專為狹窄道路設計的微型電動車Racco，進軍當地規模最大的輕型車市場，尋找下一個海外成長動能。
paras_en: China's electric‑vehicle leader BYD (01211‑HK) saw its second‑quarter profit jump almost 30% year‑on‑year, ending four consecutive quarters of decline. Amid weak domestic demand, a sharp rise in overseas exports and strong sales of higher‑priced models were the main drivers of the rebound.

Based on BYD’s half‑year report released on Friday (the 28th), Q2 net profit rose 29.8% to RMB 8.2 billion (about $1.22 billion), slightly above Bloomberg analysts’ average forecast of RMB 8.0 billion, and reversed a 55.4% plunge in Q1. Quarterly revenue fell 3.2% year‑on‑year to RMB 194.6 billion, a narrower decline than the 11.8% drop in Q1, though it marks the fourth straight quarter of revenue decline.

BYD had previously been hit by a price war in China’s EV market and competition from rivals such as Xiaomi (01810‑HK) and Xpeng (09868‑HK) (XPEV‑US), leaving profits depressed for a year. To reduce reliance on the Chinese market, the company has been actively expanding in South America, Europe and Southeast Asia, boosting sales by launching new models and refreshed popular cars. Because overseas prices and margins are generally higher than in China, export growth has also improved overall profitability.

The slump in China’s auto market shows no clear signs of improvement. Continued price cuts and promotions by manufacturers have led most automakers, including BYD, to record lower July revenues compared with the same month last year. Data from the China Passenger Car Association show that July’s total passenger‑car sales in China fell 21% year‑on‑year, while overseas sales of Chinese passenger cars surged 88%, highlighting exports as the primary growth engine for Chinese car makers.

BYD sold 1.81 million vehicles in the first half of the year, still far short of its full‑year target of 5‑5.5 million units, and July’s delivery performance was insufficient to keep the company on track for its annual goal. Nevertheless, analysts expect that as production issues are gradually resolved and exports keep climbing, BYD’s profit recovery in the second half could accelerate, with Q4 revenue and profit potentially both hitting historic highs.

Overseas expansion still faces policy risks. The EU is considering tariffs on Chinese hybrid vehicles, and BYD’s flagship plant in Hungary has been delayed to the fourth quarter after its subcontractor became embroiled in labor disputes and the project came under investigation for government subsidies, tax incentives and environmental exemptions—about a year later than originally planned. BYD says it complies with all local laws and regulations.

In addition, BYD has begun selling its micro‑electric vehicle Racco, designed for narrow roads, in the traditionally hard‑to‑enter Japanese market, targeting the country’s largest light‑vehicle segment and seeking the next overseas growth driver.

items.title: 預測市場看好Anthropic挑戰SpaceX 爭奪2026年最大規模IPO
items.title_en: Forecast Markets Favor Anthropic Over SpaceX for the Largest 2026 IPO
paras: SpaceX 今年IPO成功集資 857 億美元，幾乎是先前歷史最高紀錄的三倍之多。然而，這座歷史王冠可能很快就會易主。根據預測市場的最新數據，人工智慧(AI)新創公司 Anthropic 有望在今年奪下最大規模 IPO 的頭銜。
根據 Kalshi 和 Polymarket 等預測平台的交易資料，投資人認為 Anthropic 很有可能超越 SpaceX。截至 8 月 26 日，Polymarket 上的交易員評估 Anthropic 超越 SpaceX 的機率已達 63%。對比四個星期前，交易員當時幾乎認為這毫無可能，情勢在短期內發生了意想不到的轉變。
SpaceX 上市時定價為每股 135 美元，發行約 5.556 億股，估值達 1.77 兆美元；而 Anthropic 此次 IPO 的目標估值，一些市場人士預估可能高達 2 兆美元。
這家開發出 Claude 大型語言模型的 AI 新創之所以能在短短一個月內點燃市場熱情，關鍵在於其驚人的營收成長。根據《彭博》報導，Anthropic 的年化營收運轉率(annual run rate)已從 2025 年底的約 90 億美元，暴增至 2026 年 7 月底的 650 億美元。
此外，Anthropic 擁有 Meta(META-US) 和微軟(MSFT-US)等高知名度的長期訂閱客戶，並獲得亞馬遜(AMZN-US)與 Alphabet(GOOGL-US) 的強力注資，兩者持股比例分別約為 21% 和 14%。
然而，專欄作家Sean Williams對此熱潮提出警示。Williams指出，如何支撐如此天文數字般的估值是兩家公司共同面臨的最大難題。
SpaceX 上市時的股價營收比(P/S 比)超過了 2025 年營收的 100 倍。Williams強調，從歷史經驗來看，沒有任何一家處於顛覆性科技浪潮前沿的公司，能長期維持 30 倍以上的 P/S 比。即使以最新的年化營收計算，Anthropic 顯然也已深處歷史泡沫區。
此外，Williams提到，過去三十年來，沒有任何一項革命性科技能避免早期的泡沫破裂，這是因為投資人總是過度高估新技術的普及與優化速度。雖然目前 AI 基礎設施的支出極高，但企業要真正優化並應用 AI 解決方案，恐怕還需要數年時間。
Williams進一步引述 Truist Financial 的數據指出，過去 14 年中，前 30 大最熱門科技 IPO 股在上市第一年的平均最大回撤高達 55%。而 SpaceX 從上市後的高點至今，最大跌幅也已達到了 54%。
Williams最後建議，儘管預測市場預期 Anthropic 將改寫華爾街的歷史，但散戶投資人在此時最好還是保持距離，切勿盲目追逐熱點。
paras_en: SpaceX’s IPO this year raised $85.7 billion, nearly three times the previous historical record. However, that crown may soon change hands. According to the latest data from forecast markets, AI startup Anthropic is poised to claim the title of the largest IPO this year.

Based on trading data from prediction platforms such as Kalshi and Polymarket, investors think Anthropic is very likely to surpass SpaceX. As of August 26, Polymarket traders assessed the probability of Anthropic overtaking SpaceX at 63%, a dramatic shift from four weeks earlier when traders thought it was almost impossible.

SpaceX priced its shares at $135 each, issuing about 555.6 million shares for a valuation of $1.77 trillion; Anthropic’s target valuation for this IPO is estimated by some market participants to be as high as $2 trillion.

The AI startup behind the Claude large‑language model has ignited market enthusiasm within a month, driven by astonishing revenue growth. Bloomberg reports Anthropic’s annual run rate jumped from roughly $9 billion at the end of 2025 to $65 billion by the end of July 2026.

Anthropic also counts high‑profile long‑term subscription customers such as Meta (META‑US) and Microsoft (MSFT‑US), and has received strong backing from Amazon (AMZN‑US) and Alphabet (GOOGL‑US), which hold about 21% and 14% of the company respectively.
Columnist Sean Williams cautions against the hype, noting that supporting such astronomical valuations is the biggest challenge facing both companies.

SpaceX’s price‑to‑sales (P/S) ratio at listing exceeded 100 times its 2025 revenue. Williams stresses that historically no company at the forefront of a disruptive tech wave has sustained a P/S above 30× for long. Even using the latest annual run rate, Anthropic appears deep in a historical bubble zone.

Williams also points out that in the past thirty years no revolutionary technology has avoided an early‑stage bubble burst, because investors consistently overestimate the speed of adoption and optimization. Although AI infrastructure spending is currently very high, it may still take years for firms to truly optimize and deploy AI solutions.

Williams further cites Truist Financial data showing that over the past 14 years, the 30 most popular tech IPO stocks averaged a maximum first‑year drawdown of 55%. SpaceX’s peak‑to‑trough decline since its listing has already reached 54%.
Williams concludes that while forecast markets expect Anthropic to rewrite Wall Street history, retail investors are better off staying away and not blindly chasing the hype.

items.title: 欣興指今遭檢調調查對財務及業務並沒有重大影響 外資砸42.77億元大買
items.title_en: Xinxing says today's investigation by prosecutors has no material impact on its finances or operations; foreign investors pour NT$4.277 billion in buying
paras: ABF及PCB廠欣興電子(3037-TW)今(28)日盤中股價以1230元改寫歷史新天價，但終場收黑下跌5.93%或70元，以1100元作收，欣興今天盤後透過重訊證實，遭桃園地檢署以涉及妨害農工商罪進行搜查，全力配合檢調單位調查，並強調公司營運正常，對財務、業務並無重大影響。
今天三大法人由外資砸42.77億元買超欣興3673張，但本土法人則站在賣方，投信賣超13張，自營商賣超519張，三大法人合計買超3141張。
欣興 2026 年第第二季營收 428.9 億元，創新高，毛利率 24.08%，季增 6.84 個百分點 ，年增 11.72 個百分點，2026 年第二季稅後純益 131.15 億元，季增 1.6 倍，年增 441 倍，每股純益 8.45 元。
欣興 2026 年上半年 營收爲 625.56 億元，毛利率 21.61%，年增 8.39 個百分點，上半年稅後純益 193.56 億元，年增 18.23 倍，每股純益達 11.7 元。
paras_en: ABF and PCB fab Xinxing Electronics (3037‑TW) saw its intraday price hit a historic high of NT$1,230 today (28th), but closed down 5.93% or NT$70 at NT$1,100. After market, the company confirmed via a major announcement that the Taoyuan District Prosecutors Office conducted a search related to alleged obstruction of agriculture, industry and commerce, and Xinxing is fully cooperating with the investigation. It emphasized that operations remain normal and there is no material impact on its finances or business.

Today the three major institutional investors saw foreign investors net buy 3,673 shares of Xinxing for NT$42.77 billion, while domestic institutions were net sellers: investment trusts sold 13 shares, proprietary traders sold 519 shares, resulting in a combined net purchase of 3,141 shares by the three major groups.

Xinxing’s Q2 2026 revenue reached NT$42.89 billion, a record high, with a gross margin of 24.08%, up 6.84 percentage points quarter‑over‑quarter and 11.72 points year‑over‑year. Q2 2026 after‑tax net profit was NT$13.115 billion, 1.6 times the prior quarter and 441 times the same quarter last year, yielding earnings per share of NT$8.45.

For the first half of 2026, Xinxing reported revenue of NT$62.556 billion, gross margin 21.61%, up 8.39 percentage points year‑over‑year. H1 after‑tax net profit was NT$19.356 billion, 18.23 times the prior year, with earnings per share of NT$11.7.

items.title: 鴻海和發新能源專案獲LEED 黃金級認證 建築能源成本省逾50%
items.title_en: Foxconn’s HeFa New Energy Project Earns LEED Gold Certification, Cutting Building Energy Costs by Over 50%
paras: 鴻海(2317-TW)今(28)日宣佈，位於高雄市鴻海電芯研發暨試量產中心內的「和發新能源專案」正式取得LEED BD+C v4黃金級認證，建築整體能源成本相較ASHRAE 90.1基準節省達50%以上，室內用水亦較LEED基準節省40%以上。
和發產業園區的鴻海電芯研發暨試量產中心，主要業務為提供電動巴士、乘用車及儲能電芯等應用所需，產能可以達到1GWh；而「和發新能源專案」為中心內四層辦公建築，總樓地板面積約8,000平方公尺。
不同於單純透過個別設備改善建築效能，「和發新能源專案」從規劃初期即將能源、水資源、基地生態、交通及使用者健康納入整體設計考量，在提升建築環境績效的同時，也兼顧工作環境的健康、舒適與長期營運效率。
在能源使用方面，透過建築與機電系統設計，並充分利用和發園區空間，於廠房屋頂及地面停車棚大面積建置太陽光電系統，整合建築節能與再生能源策略。
經能源模擬評估，整體能源成本相較ASHRAE 90.1建築耗能基準節省超過50%，有效降低建築營運階段的能源需求及環境衝擊；停車空間的太陽光電棚架也讓原有空間進一步具備再生能源生產功能。
此外，採用金級省水器具及定流量節流器，室內節水逾 40%、綠化率達 30%，室內依循 ASHRAE 62.1 標準導入足量新風系統與 MERV 13 高效濾網，搭配 CO₂ 與 IAQ 感測器持續監測，兼顧節能與空氣品質。
paras_en: Foxconn (2317‑TW) announced today (the 28th) that the “HeFa New Energy Project” located within its Kaohsiung Cell R&D and Pilot Production Center has officially received LEED BD+C v4 Gold certification. The building’s overall energy consumption is more than 50% lower than the ASHRAE 90.1 baseline, and indoor water use is also more than 40% lower than the LEED benchmark.

The HeFa Industrial Park’s Foxconn Cell R&D and Pilot Production Center primarily supplies battery cells for electric buses, passenger vehicles and energy‑storage applications, with a capacity of up to 1 GWh. The “HeFa New Energy Project” is a four‑story office building within the center, covering roughly 8,000 square metres of floor area.

Unlike projects that rely solely on individual equipment upgrades, the HeFa New Energy Project incorporated energy, water resources, site ecology, transportation and occupant health into its overall design from the planning stage. This holistic approach improves building environmental performance while also ensuring a healthy, comfortable workplace and long‑term operational efficiency.

In terms of energy use, the building and MEP system design, together with extensive use of the HeFa park’s space, installed large‑scale solar photovoltaic arrays on the factory roof and ground‑level parking canopies, integrating energy‑saving measures with renewable‑energy generation.

Energy‑simulation results show that total energy costs are more than 50% lower than the ASHRAE 90.1 reference building, substantially reducing operational energy demand and environmental impact. The solar canopies over parking areas also add renewable‑energy production capability to existing space.

In addition, gold‑rated water‑saving fixtures and flow‑restrictors achieve over 40% indoor water savings, with a 30% greening ratio. The building follows ASHRAE 62.1 by providing ample fresh‑air ventilation and MERV‑13 high‑efficiency filters, complemented by CO₂ and IAQ sensors for continuous monitoring, balancing energy efficiency with indoor air quality.

items.title: 〈國泰金法說〉AI帶動企金放款強勁 國泰世華銀全年NIM展望樂觀上調
items.title_en: Cathay Financial Earnings Call: AI Fuels Strong Corporate Lending, Cathay United Bank Raises Full-Year NIM Outlook Optimistically
paras: 國泰金控(2882-TW)今(28)日舉行 2026 年第二季法說會，國泰世華銀行上半年稅後純益 270 億元創歷年同期新高，ROE 達 16.9%，副總傅伯昇指出，受惠於台灣總體經濟強勁、企業資本支出需求熱絡，企業放款年增 21%，在資金成本控制得宜與外幣放款收益提升帶動下，銀行正式將全年淨利差(NIM)目標上調至 1.63%~1.65%。房貸業務則因應央行政策維持審慎控管，整體信用成本與資產品質保持健全可控。
國泰世華銀行 2026 年上半年展現強勁的營運動能，稅後純益達 270 億元，創下歷年同期新高紀錄，股東權益報酬率(ROE)達 16.9%。銀行獲利大幅躍進主要歸功於放款規模擴大、外幣放款動能強勁、結構優化帶動資金成本降低，以及手續費收入爆發性成長。其中，財富管理手收受惠於資本市場熱絡，共同基金與證券商品手續費呈現 60% 至 74% 的強勁增幅，全年度手續費收入維持雙位數成長目標不變。
放款業務結構方面，國泰金財務長陳晏如指出，受惠於供應鏈重組及企業海外資本支出需求熱絡，國泰世華外幣放款表現極為亮眼，年成長高達 34%(即便排除匯率影響，年增率仍達 26%)；此外，中小企業放款亦維持穩健步調，年成長達 7%。
在淨利差(NIM)與存放利差(Spread)的展望上，國泰世華副總暨私人銀行執行長傅伯昇指出，銀行在資金成本控管上極具優勢，加上外幣放款收益提升，上半年 NIM 已來到 1.61%，最近幾個月持續攀升。

傅伯昇表示， 原先國泰世華對全年 NIM 展望是採取相對比較保守的態度，主因難以預測台美央行的貨幣政策變化，不過，最近一段時間觀察，尤其是荷姆茲海峽相關影響之後，亞洲國家陸續有通膨壓力與升息空間，美國 Fed 也採取相對鷹派立場。在台幣利率走揚、外幣放款動能強勁與資金成本控管良好的情況下，國泰世華已將全年度 NIM 展望上調至 1.63% 到 1.65% 左右的水準，存放利差上揚的走勢同樣非常樂觀。
媒體關注科技業與 AI 產業帶動的資金需求，傅伯昇分析，內部並未將 AI 單獨劃分為特定專案，而是看到台灣總體經濟整體強勁好轉，帶動各行各業強烈的資本支出與營運資金需求。經營團隊預估，雙位數的企業放款成長動能將一路延續至今年下半年乃至明年。
至於不動產市場與房貸政策，國泰世華仍秉持嚴謹審慎的風控態度，傅伯昇表示，央行對不動產市場維持緊縮態度，銀行內部策略趨於保守嚴謹，上半年房貸放款年增率控管在 9.3%。
在風險加權資產資源配置上，銀行將更多資源傾斜至收益與動能更佳的企業金融領域。資產品質方面，上半年淨提存信用成本維持在 24 個基點，主要是隨放款增加依法進行正常提存，逾放與呆帳回收皆維持健康可控狀態。
paras_en: Cathay Financial Holding (2882-TW) held its Q2 2026 earnings conference today (28th). Cathay United Bank posted a record half-year after‑tax profit of NT$27 billion, its highest ever for the same period, with an ROE of 16.9%. Deputy General Manager Fu Po‑sheng said the strong overall Taiwanese economy and robust corporate capital‑expenditure demand lifted corporate loan growth 21% year‑on‑year. With effective funding‑cost control and higher foreign‑currency loan yields, the bank formally raised its full‑year net interest margin (NIM) target to 1.63%‑1.65%. Mortgage lending is being managed prudently in line with central‑bank policy, keeping overall credit costs and asset quality sound and controllable.

Cathay United Bank demonstrated strong operating momentum in the first half of 2026, delivering an after‑tax profit of NT$27 billion – a new record for the period – and an ROE of 16.9%. The profit surge stemmed mainly from expanded loan volumes, vigorous foreign‑currency loan activity, structural optimisation that lowered funding costs, and explosive growth in fee income. Wealth‑management fees benefited from a lively capital market, with mutual‑fund and securities‑product fees jumping 60% to 74%, and the bank maintains its goal of double‑digit annual fee‑income growth.

Regarding loan‑business structure, CFO Chen Yan‑ru noted that supply‑chain restructuring and strong overseas corporate cap‑ex demand made Cathay United’s foreign‑currency loans shine, posting a 34% year‑over‑year increase (still 26% even after stripping out exchange‑rate effects). Meanwhile, SME loans grew steadily at a 7% annual rate.

On NIM and spread outlook, Deputy General Manager and Private‑Banking CEO Fu Po‑sheng said the bank enjoys a strong advantage in funding‑cost management, and with higher foreign‑currency loan yields the half‑year NIM reached 1.61% and has been climbing in recent months.

Fu Po‑sheng explained that the bank’s original full‑year NIM outlook was relatively conservative because of uncertainty around Taiwan and U.S. central‑bank policy. However, recent observations—especially after the Holm‑z Strait‑related developments—show Asian economies facing inflation pressures and room for rate hikes, while the U.S. Fed has taken a more hawkish stance. With rising TWD rates, strong foreign‑currency loan momentum and good cost control, Cathay United has lifted its full‑year NIM guidance to roughly 1.63%‑1.65%, and the spread outlook is similarly upbeat.

The media has focused on tech and AI‑driven funding demand. Fu Po‑sheng said AI is not treated as a separate project internally; rather, the overall robust Taiwanese economy is spurring strong capital‑expenditure and working‑capital needs across sectors. Management expects double‑digit corporate‑loan growth to continue through the second half of this year and into next year.

Regarding the real‑estate market and mortgage policy, Cathay United remains disciplined in risk control. Fu Po‑sheng noted that the central bank maintains a tightening stance on real estate, and the bank’s internal strategy is conservative, keeping the half‑year mortgage‑loan growth rate at a controlled 9.3% year‑on‑year.

In risk‑weighted‑asset allocation, the bank is shifting more resources toward the higher‑return, higher‑momentum corporate‑finance segment. Asset quality stayed solid, with net provision for credit costs at 24 basis points in the first half, reflecting normal provisioning as loan volumes rose, while overdue and bad‑loan recoveries remained healthy and controllable.

items.title: 成本與CBAM雙重壓力籠罩 華新9月調漲316產品每公噸5000元
items.title_en: Cost and CBAM Dual Pressure Loom Over Hwa Hsin; September 316 Product Price Raised by 5,000 NTD per Ton
paras: 華新(1605-TW)今(28)日開出9月盤價，指出受到原物料價格維持高檔，加上歐盟碳邊境調整機制(CBAM)推動，生產成本持續攀升，因此上調304、304含銅以及316產品，其中316產品調漲最多，每公噸上漲5000元。
華新表示，受地緣政治與印尼限縮鎳礦開採政策影響，不銹鋼主要原料包括鎳、銅、鉬等價格維持高檔，加上隨著歐盟推動CBAM，鋼廠減排壓力加劇，使得整體生產成本持續攀升，因此調整304、304含銅以及316產品。
華新進一步表示，304每公噸調漲3000元，304含銅每公噸調漲4000元，316每公噸調漲5000元。另外，200系及300系則維持平盤。
paras_en: Hwa Hsin (1605‑TW) today (28th) released its September price list, noting that raw‑material prices remain at high levels and that the EU Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM) is being implemented, causing production costs to keep climbing. As a result, it is raising prices for 304, 304 with copper and 316 products, with the 316 product seeing the largest increase of 5,000 NTD per ton.

Hwa Hsin said that geopolitical tensions and Indonesia’s restrictions on nickel mining have kept the prices of key stainless‑steel raw materials—including nickel, copper and molybdenum—high. Coupled with the EU’s rollout of CBAM, steel mills face heightened emission‑reduction pressure, driving overall production costs higher, prompting adjustments to 304, 304 with copper and 316 products.
Hwa Hsin further stated that the price of 304 will rise by 3,000 NTD per ton, 304 with copper by 4,000 NTD per ton, and 316 by 5,000 NTD per ton. The 200 series and 300 series will remain unchanged.

items.title: 鮮活果汁-KY在Q2賺回逾半個股本  上半年EPS達8.98元
items.title_en: Fresh Juice KY Earns Back Over Half of Its Capital in Q2, H1 EPS Reaches NT$8.98
paras: 鮮活果汁-KY(1256-TW)今(28)日公布最新獲利資訊，2026年第二季稅後純益2.05億元，季增77.39%，年增68.07%，單季每股純益5.74元；2026年1-6月稅後賺3.21億元，年增1.18倍，每股純益8.98元。
鮮活果汁-KY2026年第二季營收爲15.06億元，毛利率33.44%，季增3.05個百分點，年增2.89個百分點，單季稅後純益2.05億元，季增77.39%，年增68.07%，單季每股純益5.74元。
鮮活果汁-KY在2026年1-6月營收26.48億元，毛利率32.12%，年增4.27個百分點，稅後純益達3.21億元，年增1.18倍，每股純益8.98元。
鮮活果汁-KY指出，面對新茶飲產業邁入「精細化發展」階段，品牌業者更聚焦產品創新、供應鏈效率與食品安全；鮮活憑藉完整的果汁與果粒產品線，加上深厚的研發與生產優勢，將持續滿足茶飲品牌的升級需求。
展望產業環境，鮮活果汁-KY指出，近期中國各地持續推出暑期出行、文旅活動、體育賽事及消費券等促消費措施，為新茶飲市場營運提供支撐，且中國國務院正式批准擴大消費「十五五」規劃，政策重心由過去的刺激消費進一步轉向提高消費率，透過消費者收入提升、消費環境優化及消費結構升級，推動內需市場持續擴大。對食品飲料產業而言，政策方向將有助於消費需求改善與消費結構升級並行發展。
而隨著中國消費市場逐步回暖，鮮活果汁-KY指出，加上新茶飲產業持續朝健康化、多元化、精細化方向發展，市場對高品質、差異化原料的需求仍具成長空間，公司將持續掌握消費趨勢與客戶需求，深化產品研發及供應鏈整合，並透過產能布局與生產效率提升，強化服務客戶及快速回應市場的能力；同時持續拓展新產品及應用場景，積極把握消費升級與產業結構調整所帶來的市場機會，推動下半年營運延續穩健成長動能。
paras_en: Fresh Juice KY (1256‑TW) announced today (28th) its latest profit figures: Q2 2026 after‑tax net profit was NT$205 million, up 77.39% quarter‑over‑quarter and 68.07% year‑over‑year, yielding earnings per share of NT$5.74 for the quarter; for the first half of 2026 the after‑tax profit was NT$321 million, a 1.18‑fold increase year‑over‑year, with EPS of NT$8.98.

In Q2 2026 Fresh Juice KY recorded revenue of NT$1.506 billion, a gross margin of 33.44% – up 3.05 percentage points quarter‑over‑quarter and 2.89 points year‑over‑year. After‑tax net profit for the quarter was NT$205 million, up 77.39% quarter‑over‑quarter and 68.07% year‑over‑year, resulting in EPS of NT$5.74.

For the January‑June 2026 period Fresh Juice KY generated revenue of NT$2.648 billion, with a gross margin of 32.12%, a year‑over‑year increase of 4.27 percentage points. After‑tax net profit reached NT$321 million, a 1.18‑fold rise year‑over‑year, and EPS was NT$8.98.

Fresh Juice KY noted that as the new tea‑drink industry moves into a “refined development” stage, brands are focusing more on product innovation, supply‑chain efficiency and food safety. Leveraging its complete juice and fruit‑piece product lines together with strong R&D and manufacturing capabilities, Fresh Juice will continue to meet the upgrading needs of tea‑drink brands.

Looking ahead, Fresh Juice KY pointed out that recent summer travel promotions, cultural‑tourism activities, sports events and consumer vouchers across China are supporting the new tea‑drink market. The Chinese State Council has also formally approved an expanded “14th‑15th Five‑Year” consumption plan, shifting policy focus from merely stimulating consumption to raising consumption rates through higher consumer incomes, better consumption environments and upgraded consumption structures, thereby expanding domestic demand. For the food‑beverage sector, this policy direction should help improve consumer demand while upgrading consumption patterns simultaneously.

As China’s consumer market gradually recovers, Fresh Juice KY added that the new tea‑drink industry continues to evolve toward health‑orientation, diversification and refinement, keeping demand for high‑quality, differentiated ingredients on a growth trajectory. The company will keep tracking consumer trends and client needs, deepen product R&D and supply‑chain integration, and enhance capacity layout and production efficiency to better serve customers and respond quickly to market changes. It will also keep expanding new products and application scenarios, actively seizing market opportunities created by consumption upgrades and industry‑structure adjustments, to sustain robust growth momentum in the second half of the year.

items.title: 信昌電現金減資6% 10/7起暫停交易、19日新股上櫃
items.title_en: Xinchang Electronics to Reduce Capital by 6% in Cash, Trading Halted from Oct 7, New Shares Listed on Oct 19
paras: 被動元件廠信昌電(6173-TW)預計現金減資6%，今(28)日公告換發股票相關日程，舊股票將於 10 月 7 日至 10 月 16 日暫停交易，新股將於 10 月 19 日恢復換發上櫃買賣，現金減資退還股款則預計於 10 月 23 日正式發放。
信昌電為提升股東權益，辦理現金減資退還股本 1.027億元，每仟股換發 940 股、每股將退還股東 0.6 元現金，信昌電原已實收資本額為17.12億元，減資後實收資本額將降至16.09 億元。
信昌電7月營收5.37億元，月增6.6%、年增49.1%，自結稅後純益1.73億元，年增125%，每股純益1.01元；若加計上半年財報，累計前7月營收29.4億元，年增22%，稅後純益約6.84億元，每股純益約3.99元，賺贏去年全年。
信昌電所屬的華科集團董事長焦佑衡日前指出，此波被動元件缺貨狀況跟過去全面缺有點不太一樣，主要是某些特殊的品項蠻缺的，集團也將針對在 AI 相關領域的各式被動元件擴產。
paras_en: Passive component maker Xinchang Electronics (6173‑TW) plans a 6% cash capital reduction and today (28th) announced the schedule for the share exchange. The old shares will be suspended from October 7 to October 16, and the new shares will resume over‑the‑counter trading on October 19. The cash returned from the reduction is expected to be paid on October 23.

To boost shareholders’ equity, Xinchang Electronics will return NT$1.027 billion of capital, exchanging every 1,000 old shares for 940 new shares and refunding NT$0.6 per share in cash. The company’s paid‑in capital was previously NT$17.12 billion and will fall to NT$16.09 billion after the reduction.

In July, Xinchang Electronics reported revenue of NT$5.37 billion, up 6.6% month‑over‑month and 49.1% year‑over‑year, with after‑tax net profit of NT$1.73 billion, a 125% annual increase, and earnings of NT$1.01 per share. Including the first half of the year, cumulative revenue through July reached NT$29.4 billion, up 22% YoY, with after‑tax net profit of about NT$6.84 billion and earnings of roughly NT$3.99 per share, surpassing last year’s full‑year results.

Jiao Youheng, chairman of the Huake Group that owns Xinchang Electronics, recently noted that the current shortage of passive components differs from past widespread shortages; the scarcity is mainly in certain specialized items. The group will expand production of various passive components used in AI‑related applications.

items.title: 台灣大「大哥付你分期」延伸至跨境平台 擴大支付版圖
items.title_en: Taiwan Mobile Expands "Big Brother Pay You Installments" to Cross‑Border Platforms, Broadening Payment Reach
paras: 台灣大(3045-TW)今(28)日指出，隨著全球先買後付(BNPL)電商交易額持續提高，旗下「大哥付你分期」也擴大平台合作，從momo、91APP等國內電商場景，延伸至國際跨境集運與代購平台Buy&Ship，進一步拓展支付版圖。
台灣大電信金融副總吳建頤指出，BNPL正從單一通路的結帳選項，轉向可跨平台使用的彈性支付工具。2025年「大哥付你分期」交易額年增64%，用戶數也年增超過6成。此次接入Buy&Ship，再將服務從momo、91APP等國內電商延伸至跨境購物。
台灣大表示，「大哥付你分期」此次導入Buy&Ship，讓消費者在跨境集運與代購服務外，增加分期付款選擇，可依自身財務狀況，安排海外購物產生的集中支出。此外，跨境消費的購買動機也正從價格導向，延伸至海外限定商品、稀有珍藏與興趣型商品。
台灣大進一步提到，從大型綜合電商、品牌電商到跨境購物，將持續把BNPL服務嵌入不同購物路徑，讓分期支付不受單一平台限制，擴大消費者可選擇的支付場景。
至於BNPL現況，根據Worldpay《Global Payments Report 2026》預估，全球 BNPL 電商交易額至2030年將達5000億美元。
paras_en: Taiwan Mobile (3045‑TW) said on the 28th that as global buy‑now‑pay‑later (BNPL) e‑commerce transaction volumes continue to rise, its "Big Brother Pay You Installments" service is expanding platform partnerships, moving beyond domestic e‑commerce sites such as momo and 91APP to the international cross‑border consolidation and purchasing platform Buy&Ship, further extending its payment footprint.

Wu Chien‑yi, Vice President of Telecom Finance at Taiwan Mobile, noted that BNPL is shifting from a single‑channel checkout option to a flexible payment tool usable across platforms. He projected that by 2025 the "Big Brother Pay You Installments" transaction volume will grow 64% year‑over‑year, with user numbers increasing by more than 60% annually. The integration with Buy&Ship now extends the service from domestic e‑commerce sites like momo and 91APP to cross‑border shopping.

Taiwan Mobile said that the introduction of Buy&Ship into "Big Brother Pay You Installments" gives consumers an additional installment‑payment option for cross‑border consolidation and purchasing services, allowing them to schedule large overseas shopping expenses according to their financial situation. Moreover, the motivation for cross‑border purchases is shifting from pure price considerations to overseas‑exclusive items, rare collectibles, and interest‑driven products.

The company added that from large‑scale comprehensive e‑commerce and brand‑specific sites to cross‑border shopping, it will continue embedding BNPL services into various purchasing pathways, ensuring installment payments are not limited to a single platform and expanding the range of payment scenarios available to consumers.
According to Worldpay’s Global Payments Report 2026, global BNPL e‑commerce transaction volume is projected to reach $500 billion by 2030.

items.title: 〈台幣〉資金簇擁匯入 升8分收31.628元 連5周升值共7.3角
items.title_en: Taiwan Dollar Gains as Funds Flood In, Rises 8 cents to 31.628, Up 7.3 cents Over Five Weeks
paras: 在資金持續匯入的態勢下，新台幣今(28)日全日處在升值格局，終場收在31.628元，升值8分，台北外匯經紀公司成交值16.8億美元，已連續升值5周，累計升值7.3角。
新台幣今日以31.69元、升值1.8分開出後，最高來到31.57元，全日高低價差1.2角。
觀察主要亞幣，韓元強勁升值近0.7%，新台幣收升0.25%，星元和人民幣升值0.05%上下，日元貶值約0.15%，泰銖貶0.2%。
法人分析，市場持續關注聯準會貨幣政策和美債殖利率走向，目前台股透過良性輪動，展現多頭的高度韌性。
美國最新公布的經濟數據有，7月耐久財訂單月增率由 0.5%上升至 1.1%、大幅優於市場預期 0.5%，顯示投資力道強，不過，7月 PCE 年增率3.7%意外持平，反映通膨降溫情形停滯，因此，市場等待聯準會主席華許將於央行年會發表的演說內容，密切牽動股匯市變動。
paras_en: Amid continued inflows of capital, the New Taiwan dollar was in an appreciation pattern throughout the day on the 28th, closing at 31.628 per US dollar, up 8 cents. Taipei foreign‑exchange brokerage firms recorded a turnover of US$1.68 billion, marking the fifth consecutive week of appreciation and a cumulative gain of 7.3 cents.
The New Taiwan dollar opened at 31.69, up 1.8 cents, and peaked at 31.57 during the session, with a daily high‑low spread of 1.2 cents.

Looking at major Asian currencies, the Korean won surged about 0.7%, the New Taiwan dollar rose 0.25%, the Singapore dollar and the Chinese yuan each gained roughly 0.05%, the Japanese yen weakened by about 0.15%, and the Thai baht fell 0.2%.

Analysts note that the market remains focused on the Federal Reserve’s monetary policy and U.S. Treasury yield trends. Meanwhile, Taiwan’s equity market is showing strong resilience through healthy sector rotation, reflecting bullish sentiment.

The latest U.S. economic data showed July durable goods orders rising month‑over‑month from 0.5% to 1.1%, far beating the 0.5% forecast and indicating robust investment demand. However, July’s PCE price index year‑over‑year held steady at 3.7%, suggesting that inflation cooling has stalled. Consequently, markets are awaiting remarks from Fed Chair Jerome Powell at the central bank’s annual meeting, which could heavily influence equities and currency movements.

items.title: 美國經濟警訊浮現！8月消費者信心下滑 芝加哥PMI意外萎縮
items.title_en: US Economic Warning Emerges! August Consumer Confidence Slides, Chicago PMI Unexpectedly Contracts
paras: 美國8月消費者信心3個月來首度下滑，芝加哥地區商業活動更意外跌入萎縮區間，顯示家庭與企業對經濟前景的擔憂同步升高。儘管短期通膨預期降溫，物價與汽油價格居高不下，仍持續侵蝕民眾購買力。
密西根大學周五(28日)公布，8月消費者信心指數終值降至51.7，略高於初值及《彭博》調查分析師預期，但仍是3個月來首次下滑。衡量當前經濟狀況及消費者預期的分項指標均較7月下降，受訪者對未來一年與未來5年的經濟展望也同步惡化。
各政治立場受訪者的信心全面下滑，其中共和黨支持者降幅尤其明顯，信心跌至2024年11月以來最低。
密大消費者調查主任Joanne Hsu表示，除了家庭財務壓力持續影響民眾看法，消費者也愈來愈擔憂其他領域的經濟前景可能轉弱，並認為通膨在可預見的未來仍將維持高檔。
數據顯示，消費者預估未來一年物價年增率為4%，低於初值並創3月以來最低，但仍遠高於伊朗衝突爆發前2月的3.4%，也高於2024年所有數據。未來5至10年通膨預期則連續第三個月維持3.3%，同樣高於2024年介於2.8%至3.2%的區間。
中東衝突延燒及政策不確定性，成為壓抑信心的重要因素。全美平均汽油價格8月持續高於每加侖4美元，消費者也預期短期與長期油價將進一步上漲。
企業端情況更為疲弱。8月MNI芝加哥採購經理人指數(PMI)由57.6驟降至47.1，遠低於市場預估的57.9，跌破象徵景氣擴張與萎縮分界的50，單月降幅更創新冠疫情以來最大。與此同時，企業支付價格指標反而加速上升，反映商業活動急凍之際，成本壓力仍未消退。
整體而言，即使美股徘徊歷史高點，企業活動卻浮現類似衰退的警訊，一般消費者信心也持續轉弱，凸顯美國經濟正同時面對成長降溫與通膨偏高的雙重壓力。
paras_en: US consumer confidence fell for the first time in three months in August, and business activity in the Chicago region unexpectedly slipped into contraction, indicating that worries about the economic outlook are rising simultaneously among households and firms. Although short‑term inflation expectations have cooled, prices and gasoline remain high, continuing to erode purchasing power.

The University of Michigan released its August consumer sentiment index on Friday (the 28th), with the final reading dropping to 51.7, slightly above the preliminary figure and Bloomberg analysts’ expectations, but still marking the first decline in three months. Both the current‑conditions and expectations sub‑indices fell from July, and respondents’ outlook for the next year and the next five years also deteriorated.
Confidence fell across all political affiliations, with the drop among Republican supporters especially pronounced, reaching the lowest level since November 2024.

Joanne Hsu, director of the Michigan consumer survey, said that beyond ongoing household‑financial pressure shaping public opinion, consumers are increasingly worried that other areas of the economy could weaken, and they expect inflation to remain elevated in the foreseeable future.

The data show that consumers expect prices to rise 4% over the next year, a figure lower than the preliminary estimate and the lowest since March, yet still well above the 3.4% rate recorded two months before the Iran conflict erupted and higher than any figure in 2024. Inflation expectations for the next 5‑10 years stayed at 3.3% for the third consecutive month, also above the 2024 range of 2.8%‑3.2%.

Escalating Middle‑East conflicts and policy uncertainty are key factors dampening confidence. The national average gasoline price remained above $4 per gallon throughout August, and consumers expect both short‑term and long‑term oil prices to rise further.

Business conditions are even weaker. The August MNI Chicago Purchasing Managers’ Index (PMI) plunged from 57.6 to 47.1, far below the market forecast of 57.9 and beneath the 50 threshold that separates expansion from contraction, marking the largest monthly drop since the COVID‑19 pandemic began. At the same time, the corporate price‑pay index accelerated upward, reflecting that cost pressures persist even as commercial activity freezes.

Overall, even as US equities hover near historic highs, corporate activity is showing recession‑like warning signs and consumer confidence continues to weaken, highlighting that the US economy is facing the dual pressure of slowing growth and persistently high inflation.

items.title: 華許放鷹牽動債市！2年期美債殖利率急升5基點
items.title_en: Warsh's Hawkish Tone Moves Bond Market! 2-Year US Treasury Yield Jumps 5 Basis Points
paras: 聯準會(Fed)主席華許(Kevin Warsh)周五(28日)在傑克森霍爾央行年會強調抑制通膨的決心，緩解市場對其抗通膨可信度的部分疑慮。演說期間，短期美債價格下跌、長期美債走高，殖利率曲線進一步趨平，反映投資人預期Fed可能必須升息壓制物價。
截稿前，對利率政策較為敏感的2年期美債殖利率上升5個基點至4.28%，30年期美債殖利率則下跌1個基點至5.19%。殖利率與債券價格呈反向走勢。
短債殖利率上升顯示交易員提高對Fed升息的預期，長債殖利率回落則反映市場對長期通膨失控的擔憂有所降溫。華許的演說也在一定程度上恢復投資人對Fed維護物價穩定的信心。
自華許6月首次主持記者會以來，債券交易員便持續揣測他的政策立場。華許當時強調，必須讓自2021年全球經濟走出新冠疫情後便長期高於目標的通膨降溫，語氣偏向鷹派。
不過，Fed於7月再度按兵不動，華許也拒絕預告今年是否可能升息，導致長期美債殖利率大幅攀升。投資人擔心，若Fed未能及時抑制物價，未來通膨風險將進一步升高，因此要求持有長債時獲得更高的風險補償。
華許周五表示，近期通膨數據尚未顯示物價壓力出現有意義的放緩。決策官員必須確信通膨正朝目標下降，否則Fed就「還有工作要做」。
他也重申，Fed將使通膨回到2%，並強調2%是「堅定且固定的目標」，並非可隨經濟或政治環境調整的彈性標準。相關談話讓市場認為，若接下來的通膨數據持續偏高，Fed仍可能進一步收緊貨幣政策。
paras_en: Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh emphasized his determination to curb inflation at the Jackson Hole central‑bank symposium on Friday (the 28th), easing some market doubts about the Fed’s anti‑inflation credibility. During his remarks, short‑term U.S. Treasury prices fell while long‑term Treasuries rose, flattening the yield curve and reflecting investors’ view that the Fed may need to raise rates to restrain prices.
At the close of the article, the rate‑sensitive 2‑year Treasury yield had risen 5 basis points to 4.28%, while the 30‑year yield slipped 1 basis point to 5.19%. Yields move inversely to bond prices.

The rise in short‑term yields signals traders are pricing in a higher probability of a Fed rate hike, whereas the dip in long‑term yields indicates that concerns over runaway long‑run inflation have cooled. Warsh’s speech also helped restore some investor confidence that the Fed will keep price stability intact.

Since Warsh first held a press conference in June, bond traders have been speculating about his policy stance. At that time he stressed the need to bring inflation— which had been persistently above target since the global economy emerged from the pandemic in 2021— back down, adopting a decidedly hawkish tone.

However, the Fed held rates steady again in July, and Warsh declined to signal whether another hike might come this year, prompting a sharp rise in long‑term Treasury yields. Investors worry that if the Fed fails to curb prices promptly, inflation risks will rise further, demanding higher risk premiums for holding long‑dated bonds.

Warsh said on Friday that recent inflation data have not shown a meaningful easing of price pressures. Policymakers must be convinced that inflation is moving toward the target, otherwise the Fed “still has work to do.”

He reiterated that the Fed will bring inflation back to 2% and stressed that the 2% goal is “firm and fixed,” not a flexible benchmark that can be adjusted for economic or political conditions. His comments led the market to believe that if inflation data remain elevated, the Fed could tighten monetary policy further.

items.title: 華許放鷹了！通膨不乖乖降 Fed就得繼續出手
items.title_en: Warsh Unleashes the Hawk! If Inflation Won't Calm, the Fed Must Keep Acting
paras: 聯準會(Fed)主席華許(Kevin Warsh)周五(28日)在傑克森霍爾央行年會發表上任後首場重要演說，警告美國通膨並未出現有意義的放緩，並重申2%是「堅定且固定」的目標。儘管他未明確支持9月升息，卻表示當前金融環境難言具有限制性，若基礎通膨未以足夠快的速度回落，Fed就「還有工作要做」，為進一步升息保留空間。

通膨改善不足以讓Fed放心

華許表示，Fed必須確信基礎通膨正明確且快速地朝2%目標前進，否則就必須採取行動，「這是我們的工作、使命與責任」。
他承認，今年夏季公布的個人消費支出(PCE)物價指數及消費者物價指數(CPI)均優於預期，但這些數據尚不足以證明通膨趨勢已有實質改善。Fed偏好的PCE物價指數7月年增率仍達3.7%，高於2%目標已有逾5年。
更令華許擔憂的是，漲價範圍依然廣泛。目前PCE商品與服務項目中，約有一半價格年增逾3%，儘管低於疫情後通膨高峰，仍明顯高於疫情前20年約三分之一的正常比例。
華許表示，過去兩年的抗通膨進展相當有限，目前市場通膨預期雖仍受到控制，但Fed必須密切關注，確保預期不會脫離錨定。「物價穩定不會自動發生，通膨也不一定自行回歸平均水準，讓物價恢復穩定是Fed的工作。」
他也淡化薪資成長趨緩帶來的正面訊號。傳統經濟模型通常認為薪資放緩有助壓低通膨，但華許指出，長久以來，薪資成長都不是可靠的未來通膨指標。

金融環境不緊為升息留下空間

Fed目前將聯邦基金利率維持在3.5%至3.75%，自去年12月以來已連續5次按兵不動。不過，華許認為，現行利率並未對經濟形成太大約束，信貸與放款市場幾乎看不到政策限制的跡象。
他指出，儘管房市及農業浮現部分壓力，整體金融環境仍很難被形容為具有限制性。美國經濟面對多重衝擊仍展現韌性，信用利差接近歷史低檔，企業投資成長更創2021年以來最快。
華許強調，當通膨高於2%時，Fed目前的首要關注重點就是物價，而短期利率仍是實現充分就業及物價穩定雙重使命的主要工具。相關說法被市場解讀為，若未來數據顯示通膨持續頑強，他已準備支持升息。
Fed內部對政策方向也存在分歧。7月會議維持利率不變時，共有3名官員投下反對票、主張升息，其他決策官員也表示，若通膨未能降溫，可能加入支持緊縮政策的行列。
華許表示，7月選擇等待更多資訊是較明智的做法，特別是供應鏈、投資流動及地緣政治局勢仍可能出現變化。他並未說明9月會議將採取何種行動，而是強調：「我今天承諾的是一套紀律，而不是一項決定。」

華許拒給路徑市場升息押注升溫

華許明確表示，這次演說不應被視為前瞻指引或政策反應函數。他認為，前瞻指引在危機時期或許有其作用，但在正常環境下，可能「以清晰之名製造模糊」，甚至限制決策官員在關鍵時刻作出正確選擇的自由。
他也反駁市場要求Fed明確交代短期政策路徑的呼聲，直言央行對經濟的理解尚未精準到足以提供機械化且屢試不爽的答案，影響貨幣政策的關鍵因素也會隨時間改變，投資人應自行形成對經濟及利率走向的判斷。
不過，相較前兩次記者會，華許此次更詳細說明對通膨、經濟與政策優先順序的看法，在一定程度上回應外界對其溝通缺乏清晰度的批評。Inflation Insights總裁Omair Sharif表示，華許向市場提供期待已久的通膨觀點，同時又未提前暴露政策決定，對華許與市場而言可說是雙贏。
市場隨即提高升息押注。Fed 9月升息機率由演說前約36%至40%，升至逾50%；2年期美債殖利率一度大漲9個基點至4.32%，創約一個月新高，30年期殖利率則下跌2個基點至5.17%。短債殖利率上升、長債回落，顯示投資人認為Fed可能升息壓制物價，長期通膨失控風險則有所降低。
前Fed副主席克拉里達(Richard Clarida)指出，現在每一場會議都可能調整利率；若決策官員看不到通膨改善，「他們已準備好升息」。Fed將於9月11日取得8月CPI數據，並於9月15日至16日召開利率會議，就業、失業率及通膨數據將成為決策關鍵。
paras_en: Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh delivered his first major speech since taking office on Friday (the 28th) at the Jackson Hole central bank symposium, warning that U.S. inflation has not shown a meaningful slowdown and reiterating that 2% remains a "firm and fixed" target. Although he did not explicitly endorse a September rate hike, he said the current financial environment is not clearly restrictive, and if core inflation does not fall fast enough, the Fed "still has work to do," leaving room for further tightening.
Warsh said the Fed must be convinced that core inflation is moving clearly and quickly toward the 2% goal; otherwise action is required, "that is our job, mission, and responsibility."

He acknowledged that this summer’s personal consumption expenditures (PCE) price index and consumer price index (CPI) both came in better than expected, but that the data are still insufficient to prove a substantive improvement in the inflation trend. The Fed‑preferred PCE price index’s July year‑over‑year rate remained at 3.7%, more than five years above the 2% target.

What worries Warsh even more is that price increases remain broad‑based. About half of the items in the PCE goods and services basket are seeing annual price gains above 3%; while lower than the post‑pandemic peak, this is still markedly higher than the roughly one‑third normal rate seen in the two decades before the pandemic.

Warsh noted that anti‑inflation progress over the past two years has been modest, and although market inflation expectations are still contained, the Fed must watch them closely to ensure they stay anchored. "Price stability does not happen automatically, and inflation does not necessarily revert to average levels on its own; restoring price stability is the Fed’s job," he said.

He also downplayed the positive signal from slowing wage growth. Traditional economic models often assume that slower wages help lower inflation, but Warsh pointed out that wages have long been an unreliable predictor of future inflation.

Financial conditions are not tight enough to preclude rate hikes. The Fed currently holds the federal funds rate at 3.5%‑3.75%, unchanged for five consecutive meetings since December last year. However, Warsh believes the current rate does not impose a heavy constraint on the economy, and credit and lending markets show little sign of policy‑driven restriction.

He noted that despite some pressure in the housing and agricultural sectors, the overall financial environment is far from being restrictive. The U.S. economy remains resilient amid multiple shocks, credit spreads are near historic lows, and corporate investment growth is the fastest since 2021.

Warsh emphasized that as long as inflation stays above 2%, the Fed’s primary focus remains on prices, and short‑term rates remain the main tool for achieving the dual mandate of full employment and price stability. Markets interpreted this as a signal that if data continue to show stubborn inflation, he is ready to support another hike.

There are also internal divisions within the Fed on policy direction. At the July meeting that left rates unchanged, three officials voted against the decision and advocated a hike, and other policymakers indicated they might join the tightening camp if inflation does not cool.

Warsh said waiting for more information in July was the wiser approach, especially as supply‑chain dynamics, investment flows, and geopolitical developments could still shift. He did not specify what action the September meeting would take, but stressed, "What I am committing to today is a framework of discipline, not a specific decision."

Warsh rejected market speculation that the speech signaled a hotter path for rate hikes. He made clear that the remarks should not be treated as forward guidance or a policy reaction function. He believes forward guidance may have a role in crises, but in normal times it can "create opacity under the guise of clarity" and even limit policymakers’ freedom to make the right choices at critical moments.

He also pushed back against calls for the Fed to spell out a short‑term policy path, stating that the central bank’s understanding of the economy is not precise enough to provide a mechanical, fool‑proof answer, and that the key drivers of monetary policy will evolve over time, leaving investors to form their own views on the economy and rate trajectory.

Compared with his first two press briefings, Warsh this time offered a more detailed view of his thinking on inflation, the economy, and policy priorities, partially addressing criticism of his earlier lack of clarity. Inflation Insights CEO Omair Sharif said Warsh gave the market a long‑awaited inflation perspective while not pre‑emptively revealing policy decisions, a win‑win for both Warsh and the market.

Markets immediately raised rate‑hike bets. The probability of a September Fed hike rose from roughly 36% before the speech to about 40% and then over 50%; the two‑year Treasury yield jumped 9 basis points to 4.32%, a one‑month high, while the 30‑year yield fell 2 basis points to 5.17%. The rise in short‑term yields and fall in long‑term yields suggest investors think a hike could curb prices while long‑term inflation risks are easing.

Former Fed Vice Chair Richard Clarida warned that every upcoming meeting could adjust rates; if policymakers see no inflation improvement, "they are ready to hike." The Fed will receive August CPI data on September 11 and convene its rate‑policy meeting on September 15‑16, with employment, unemployment and inflation figures set to be decisive.

Berenberg策略師Ulrich Urbahn認為，本次演說對外匯、黃金與債券市場的影響，可能大於股市。若華許在通膨、財政可信度或維持限制性政策方面釋出強硬立場，長期實質與名目殖利率可能進一步上升，同時支撐美元並壓低對利率敏感的資產。

paras_en: U.S. equity indices opened mixed on Friday (the 28th), with AI‑driven gains cooling temporarily as investors shied away from making large bets before Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh delivers a heavyweight speech at the Jackson Hole central‑bank symposium. The market is looking for Warsh to demonstrate a firm stance on curbing high inflation to stabilize the long‑term U.S. bond market; chip stocks took a brief breather, and Marvell’s earnings failed to lift investor confidence.

At the time of writing, the Dow Jones Industrial Average was up about 80 points, roughly 0.1%, the Nasdaq Composite rose about 40 points, roughly 0.2%, the S&P 500 gained about 0.2%, while the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index fell about 1.0%. TSMC ADR was up about 0.1%.

U.S. equity index futures were mixed on Friday (the 28th) as investors avoided piling in ahead of Fed Chair Kevin Warsh’s speech at the Jackson Hole central‑bank meeting, waiting for him to elaborate on the economic outlook and policy strategy to bring inflation back to the 2% target.

At the time of writing, S&P 500 futures were roughly flat, with the week still expected to close higher; Nasdaq‑100 futures gave back some of the gains sparked by Nvidia’s strong earnings forecast. PayPal (PYPL‑US) was down 14% pre‑market after private‑equity firm Advent and payments firm Stripe abandoned their bid to acquire the company.

In other markets, the dollar and gold showed little movement, Brent crude was range‑bound, and U.S. Treasury yields rose across the board, with the 30‑year yield climbing 2 basis points to 5.21%. Copper continued its upward streak for a ninth consecutive week, on track for the longest weekly rally since 2020.

Warsh is scheduled to speak at 10:00 a.m. Eastern Time. With the market questioning his resolve to tame inflation, long‑term Treasury yields have been climbing, Fed officials are split on policy, and the Treasury has stepped into the bond market, making his remarks especially closely watched.

Edmond de Rothschild asset‑management chief investment officer Nabil Milali said Warsh’s recent comments have been too vague, leaving the market unable to gauge the direction of his speech; some investors expect a very hawkish signal, others think the opposite, so they are reluctant to expand positions in the hours before the talk.

JPMorgan Chase asset‑management global market strategist Hugh Gimber noted that investors most want to understand the Fed’s policy framework for assessing economic conditions, to better interpret upcoming economic data, a piece of information the market currently lacks.

Berenberg strategist Ulrich Urbahn believes the speech’s impact could be larger on FX, gold and bond markets than on equities. If Warsh delivers a tough stance on inflation, fiscal credibility or maintaining restrictive policy, real and nominal long‑term yields could rise further, supporting the dollar and pressuring rate‑sensitive assets.

In European equities, the Stoxx 600 rebounded on a recovery in consumer stocks, potentially avoiding the longest weekly decline since early 2024. Accelerating inflation in Spain and France also bolsters the case for a European Central Bank rate hike next month.

The yen led losses among major currencies, again approaching ¥160 per dollar and moving toward its lowest level since the joint U.S.–Japan intervention at the end of July. Japan’s finance ministry reported on Friday that the government has spent a record $96.4 billion over the past month to support the yen.
